name: McLaughlin–Kairos Unified Field Theory (MKUFT) — Public Working Canon
alternateName: MKUFT — Layer Before Law: A Relational Architecture for Physical Law and Cross-Scale Dynamics
description: The evolving public working canon of the McLaughlin–Kairos Unified Field Theory by Mark Charles McLaughlin. Frozen publications retain separate DOI, version, citation and licence identities as recorded in the repository provenance and rights documents. The current canon includes addressed law assembly, property-specific law descent, recoverability, and hostile novelty-audit modules. Standalone research outputs are indexed separately from live modules so publication identity is not transferred by convenience or repository location.
headline: MKUFT — Layer Before Law: A Relational Architecture for Physical Law and Cross-Scale Dynamics
